selected_evidence.summary: The update succeeded; both installed kernel entries contain `audit=1`, including after reboot.
The post-restart live kernel command line contains `audit=1`; kernel auditing and auditd are active.

Baseline boot ID was 31949c21-52ad-47af-bdbe-893352fd509b; the safe reboot was acknowledged; node1 returned with boot ID a69ee665-109a-4f14-a6c0-ed0a7256bae2; auditd, audit data, saved boot entries, and overall system state recovered successfully.

commands.command:
cmdline=$(cat /proc/cmdline); case " $cmdline " in *" audit=1 "*) printf 'live_audit_parameter=present
' ;; *) printf 'live_audit_parameter=missing
'; exit 1 ;; esac; total=$(grubby --info=ALL | grep -c '^args='); with_audit=$(grubby --info=ALL | grep '^args=' | grep -c 'audit=1'); printf 'saved_entries=%s saved_entries_with_audit_1=%s
' "$total" "$with_audit"; [ "$total" -eq "$with_audit" ]; printf 'auditd_active='; systemctl is-active auditd; printf 'auditd_enabled='; systemctl is-enabled auditd; test -s /var/log/audit/audit.log && printf 'audit_log=present_nonempty
'; printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running
